answer: A script can invent a name in a millisecond; it cannot invent a decade. Dental technician registration with dental council attestation is the decade: three-year training, 600 supervised cases, registration exam, annual fees. The basalt is the ledger entry dated years ago, made for a purpose that had nothing to do with this epoch. To fake a hundred accounts the ring must stage a hundred such decades, and the lotus in each is the mundane evidence — receipts, visits, signatures, collected one by one. The ocean is the registry lookup, finished before the applicant has sat down.
